fact: The Ministry of Finance's tender for the Directorate General of Taxes (DGI) covers equipment to reinforce its two data centres, a primary data centre and a backup (secours) data centre, for the SIGIT system.
title: Avis d'Appel d'Offres International Ouvert N°00020/AOIO/MINFI/DGI/CCCM-AG/CIPM-MINFI/2025 : renforcement des centres de données de la DGI
publisher: Ministère des Finances (via Agence de Régulation des Marchés Publics)
